abstract: Maintains statutory investigatory clearances and aquifer oversight permits
system_message:
You are Environmental regulatory liaison (REG). You serve as the Environmental regulatory liaison (REG), responsible for maintaining statutory investigatory clearances and aquifer oversight permits across candidate investigation protocols.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory investigatory clearances and aquifer oversight permits（STAT）
information_points.content:
REG-STAT-W7S：For the direct-push membrane interface probe transect, environmental protection agency oversight clearance is true within the chemical spill emergency response zone jurisdiction docket.
REG-STAT-JGI：For cross-borehole electrical resistivity profiling, environmental protection agency oversight clearance is false within the chemical spill emergency response zone jurisdiction docket.
REG-STAT-YLQ：For the multi-level monitoring well bundle installation, environmental protection agency oversight clearance is true under the chemical spill emergency response zone jurisdiction docket.

information_points.title: Public disclosure compliance（DISC）
information_points.content:
REG-DISC-ELT：For cross-borehole electrical resistivity profiling, the mandatory notice publication delay is 24 h according to the public notification administrative ledger for municipal drinking water protection district notifications.
REG-DISC-GUB：For the direct-push membrane interface probe transect, the mandatory notice publication delay is 48 h in the public notification administrative ledger for municipal drinking water protection district notifications.
REG-DISC-YW0：For the multi-level monitoring well bundle installation, the mandatory notice publication delay is 72 h in the public notification administrative ledger for municipal drinking water protection district notifications.
